ideas.children_he: ה׳ אוֹמֵר לְמֹשֶׁה לְהָכִין שְׁנֵי לוּחוֹת אֶבֶן חֲדָשִׁים. מֹשֶׁה יַעֲלֶה עִמָּם לַהָר לְבַדּוֹ בַּבֹּקֶר.
ideas.children_en: God commands Moses to make new tablets and ascend Mount Sinai alone at dawn. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מִתְגַּלֶּה בֶּעָנָן וּמַכְרִיז שֶׁהוּא רַחוּם, סַבְלָן וְסוֹלֵחַ. מֹשֶׁה מִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וּמְבַקֵּשׁ סְלִיחָה לָעָם וְלִוּוּי בַּדֶּרֶךְ.
ideas.children_en: God appears in a cloud and proclaims His merciful nature, while Moses bows and asks forgiveness and continued presence. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מְחַדֵּשׁ אֶת הַבְּרִית וּמַבְטִיחַ נִסִּים. הָעָם צָרִיךְ לְהַרְחִיק אֱלִילִים וּלְהִזָּהֵר מִבְּרִית שֶׁתּוֹבִיל אוֹתוֹ לַעֲבֹד אוֹתָם.
ideas.children_en: God promises wondrous deeds and commands Israel to keep the covenant and reject the land’s idols and alliances. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: הָעָם צָרִיךְ לַחְגֹּג אֶת חַג הַמַּצּוֹת וּלְהַקְדִּישׁ בְּכוֹרוֹת. אֶת הַבֵּן הַבְּכוֹר פּוֹדִים בְּתַשְׁלוּם, וְאֶת בְּכוֹר הַחֲמוֹר מַחֲלִיפִים בְּשֶׂה.
ideas.children_en: Instructions are given for the Feast of Unleavened Bread, dedication of firstborn animals, and redemption of human and donkey firstborns. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: נָחִים בְּשַׁבָּת גַּם בִּזְמַן עֲבוֹדָה רַבָּה בַּשָּׂדֶה. שָׁלוֹשׁ פְּעָמִים בַּשָּׁנָה בָּאִים לַעֲבֹד אֶת ה׳, וְהוּא מַבְטִיחַ לִשְׁמֹר עַל הָאָרֶץ.
ideas.children_en: Israel is commanded to rest on the Sabbath and appear before God three times yearly, with promises of protection and expanded borders. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: שׁוֹמְרִים עַל כְּלָלֵי קָרְבַּן הַפֶּסַח וּמְבִיאִים אֶת רֵאשִׁית הַיְבוּל לַה׳. לֹא מְבַשְּׁלִים גְּדִי בַּחֲלֵב אִמּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Instructions concern the Passover sacrifice, bringing first fruits, and the prohibition against boiling a kid in its mother’s milk. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: ה׳ מְצַוֶּה לִכְתֹּב אֶת דִּבְרֵי הַבְּרִית. מֹשֶׁה נִשְׁאָר בָּהָר אַרְבָּעִים יוֹם וְלַיְלָה בְּלִי לֶאֱכֹל וְלִשְׁתּוֹת.
ideas.children_en: God commands Moses to write the covenant words, and Moses remains on the mountain forty days and nights without food or water. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה יוֹרֵד עִם הַלּוּחוֹת וְאֵינוֹ יוֹדֵעַ שֶׁפָּנָיו מְאִירוֹת. הָאוֹר בָּא אַחֲרֵי שֶׁדִּבֵּר עִם ה׳.
ideas.children_en: Moses descends with the tablets, and his face shines with radiant light after speaking with God. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה קוֹרֵא לְאַהֲרֹן וּלְמַנְהִיגֵי הָעָם. הֵם חוֹזְרִים אֵלָיו, וְהוּא מְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: Moses calls Aaron and the leaders of the congregation, and they return to hear him. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: כָּל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל נִגָּשִׁים לְמֹשֶׁה. הוּא מוֹסֵר לָהֶם אֶת כָּל הַמִּצְווֹת שֶׁקִּבֵּל בָּהָר.
ideas.children_en: All the Israelites then approach, and Moses gives them all the commandments he received from God at Mount Sinai. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: אַחֲרֵי שֶׁמֹּשֶׁה מְסַיֵּם לְדַבֵּר, הוּא מְכַסֶּה אֶת פָּנָיו בְּבַד שֶׁנִּקְרָא מַסְוֶה.
ideas.children_en: After finishing speaking with the people, Moses places a veil over his face. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.

ideas.children_he: מֹשֶׁה מוֹרִיד אֶת הַכִּסּוּי כְּשֶׁהוּא מְדַבֵּר עִם ה׳ וּמוֹסֵר דְּבָרִים לָעָם. אַחֲרֵי כֵן הוּא מְכַסֶּה שׁוּב אֶת פָּנָיו הַמְּאִירוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Moses removes the veil before God, then brings the commandments to the people; his face shines, and he covers it again until he returns to speak with God. This story invites us to think about making choices, taking responsibility, and correcting mistakes.
